👋 WELCOME — I’M RICK SHIELS

This channel is all about helping you play better golf and enjoy the game more.
I make videos for every type of golfer: beginners, weekend players, improving golfers, and low handicaps chasing new personal bests.

Here’s what you’ll find on the channel:

⭐ GOLF COACHING & LESSONS

I share simple, practical and proven golf instruction designed to help you:

• Fix your slice
• Fix your hook
• Hit your driver longer and straighter
• Improve your iron strike
• Add height, control and distance
• Learn how to draw and fade the golf ball
• Improve ball position, alignment and setup
• Build a repeatable, consistent golf swing
• Increase clubhead speed
• Improve swing path and club face control

You’ll also find full swing analysis, beginner advice, drills you can try at the range, and tips for getting better at golf quickly.

⭐ SHORT GAME & PUTTING

Lower your scores with short-game tips that help you:

• Stop duffing and thinning chips
• Improve contact and distance control
• Pitch closer to the hole
• Create more backspin
• Build confidence around the greens
• Read putts better
• Improve pace control and holing-out percentages

Short game is where most golfers drop shots — so I make sure you have everything you need to get better fast.

⭐ GOLF EQUIPMENT REVIEWS (H.I.T)

I test the latest:

• Drivers
• Irons
• Putters
• Wedges
• Golf balls
• Launch monitors
• Golf gadgets
• Budget vs premium clubs

All reviews are completely honest and independent. I use Trackman and GCQuad to give you accurate numbers you can trust.

If you’re trying to find the best golf driver, best irons, most forgiving clubs or value golf equipment — you’re in the right place.

⭐ BREAK 75 & GOLF ENTERTAINMENT

Break 75 has become one of YouTube’s biggest golf series.
You’ll see:

• Full 18-hole course vlogs
• Course management strategies
• Matches against tour players and creators
• Pressure moments, birdie runs and disaster holes
• Some of the world’s best golf courses
• Real, relatable golf

I also play matches and challenges with some of the biggest names in golf, including:

• Bryson DeChambeau
• Peter Finch
• Good Good
• GM Golf
• Bob Does Sports
• BustaJack
• Grant Horvat
• Me and My Golf
• Danny Maude

These help bring you the most entertaining and competitive golf content possible.

⭐ TRAVEL & COURSE VLOGS

I film at some of the most incredible golf destinations around the world. Expect:

• Amazing golf courses
• Behind-the-scenes access
• Player interactions
• Travel insights
• Bucket-list destinations
• Worldwide golf adventures

⭐ THE GOAL

To make golf more fun, more accessible and help you become a better, more confident, happier golfer — whether you’re breaking 100 or trying to break par. LIMITED EDITION MERCH (UK & US)

videos.title: Chicken over Fries med Caj P. Sriracha Mayo [Recept]
videos.summary_source_text:
Chicken over Fries med Caj P. Sriracha Mayo [Recept] Vår senaste obsession innehåller krispiga pommes, friterad kyckling och massor av god sås. Burgerdudes Chicken over Fries är enkel att svänga ihop med Caj P. Sriracha Mayo, som ger både krämighet och skön hetta. Ett baconregn ger extra sälta och krisp, och vi toppar med chili och allas favorit koriander. Ja, vi vet att åsikterna går isär där. Du kan enkelt köpa både pommes och kyckling från en restaurang och ta med dig, så behöver du bara fixa tillbehören och bygga ihop allt på tallriken.

🔥 Burgerdudes Chicken over Fries
2 portioner / 15 min

Du behöver:
1 stor portion pommes frites, ca 300 gram
3 bitar benfri friterad kyckling cirka 250 gram
4 skivor bacon
Caj P. Sriracha Mayo
Färsk koriander
Röd chili

Gör så här:

1.) Stek baconet krispigt och låt det rinna av på hushållspapper. Du kan hacka det eller smula det med händerna.
2.) Hacka koriandern grovt och skiva den röda chilin tunt.
3.) Dela den friterade kycklingen i mindre bitar.
4.) Lägg de varma pommesen på en tallrik och fördela kycklingen ovanpå.
5.) Ringla över rikligt med Caj P. Sriracha Mayo så att både kycklingen och pommesen täcks med sås.
6.) Avsluta med ett baconregn, följt av koriander och röd chili.

videos.title: 02.11.26 - RIFT Education Day
videos.summary_source_text:
02.11.26 - RIFT Education Day RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

RIFT — THE NEXT-GEN AFFILIATE OS

Learn. Participate. Manage Risk. Think Bigger.

videos.summary_source_text:
Avalanche Course Correct After Early Deficit, Grab Road Win Over Blackhawks Colorado Avalanche snap road woes with a commanding 5-2 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks. After an early deficit and a controversial goalie interference call, key performances from Nazem Kadri and Jaden Schwartz propelled the Avs to rally back—Kadri’s acrobatic “Superman” goal leading the charge. Is this the turning point for Colorado's struggles away from Ball Arena?

The conversation focused on Gabe Landeskog’s evolving leadership, Mackenzie Blackwood’s steady presence in net, and the impressive growth of TJ Hughes in the absence of coveted first-round picks. A key theme that emerged was inconsistency in NHL goalie interference calls, sparking heated reactions around league officiating. The discussion explored special teams' improvement, Nathan MacKinnon’s turnover concerns, and speculation on which Avs player will notch the season’s elusive first hat trick. Don’t miss these insights as Colorado eyes momentum in their next tough matchup.

videos.title: Hindi - 02.11.26 - RIFT Presentation
videos.summary_source_text:
Hindi - 02.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

videos.title: 7 Things You Have Today That Could Be Gone Tomorrow | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
7 Things You Have Today That Could Be Gone Tomorrow | Dr. Mandell One day, you may look back at your life and realize that some of the greatest blessings were the very things you barely noticed. Your health, your family, your ability to walk, breathe, see, hear, laugh, love, and simply wake up to another day are extraordinary gifts that we often take for granted. We become so busy chasing what we don't have that we forget to appreciate what is already right in front of us. Every heartbeat, every breath, every moment with someone you love, and every opportunity to experience another day is something truly precious. Your body performs countless remarkable functions every second to keep you alive, yet how often do you stop to appreciate everything it does for you? In this powerful and heartfelt motivational message, Dr. Alan Mandell shares seven important reminders that can change the way you look at your health, your happiness, your relationships, and your life. Sometimes the things we complain about today are the very things we would give anything to have back tomorrow. Don't wait until your health changes, someone you love is gone, or another chapter of your life has passed before realizing how much you had to be grateful for. True happiness isn't always about getting more. It's about recognizing the incredible value of what you already have. Take a moment today to appreciate your body, cherish the people who love you, and be thankful for the simple blessings that make life so meaningful. Because one day, you may discover that the ordinary moments were actually the most extraordinary ones. If this message touches your heart, share it with someone you love. You never know who needs this reminder today. Wishing you peace, good health, happiness, and many blessings. Dr. Alan Mandell, Motivationaldoc.

videos.title: GPT Makes 3 Scientific Discoveries, Grok BEATS ChatGPT, AI Analyzes Millions of Brain Cells: AI NEWS
videos.summary_source_text:
GPT Makes 3 Scientific Discoveries, Grok BEATS ChatGPT, AI Analyzes Millions of Brain Cells: AI NEWS Ottokit Link: https://ottokit.com/?aff=14ca2272

OpenAI just deployed 1,946 AI agents to analyze a massive mouse brain dataset in 32 minutes. The company also claims its AI models generated formal proofs of major unsolved problems in mathematics and computer science. Meanwhile, Elon Musk's xAI says Grok Voice 3.0 has surpassed ChatGPT's voice AI.

Three major AI breakthroughs. Three sets of impressive numbers. But when you examine the evidence, the story gets considerably more complicated.

OpenAI's GPT-Rosalind system used 1,946 parallel AI agents to analyze a whole-brain Perturb-seq dataset from a 2026 study by Sun and colleagues. Each agent examined a different gene perturbation, investigated cellular changes, reviewed scientific literature, and generated research hypotheses.

According to OpenAI, the entire analysis took just 32 minutes, compared with months of estimated human research time. The multi-agent system referenced more than 700 scientific sources, while a single-agent approach cited only 11.

One particularly interesting finding involved DCTN1, cholesterol-related genes, and potential connections to Parkinson's disease research.

And an existence result involving quantum chromodynamics and related physical theories.

OpenAI released machine-checkable formal proofs using Lean, a mathematical proof assistant that verifies logical steps.

But here's the critical catch.

A proof passing Lean verification doesn't automatically establish that the formalized statement perfectly represents the original mathematical conjecture. Independent mathematicians still need to examine whether the AI actually proved what OpenAI claims.

These results remain under expert scrutiny, and the physics claim has not been fully published.

If the proofs survive independent verification, the implications for mathematics, computer science, and AI-assisted discovery could be enormous. If they don't, the failures could reveal important limitations in AI-generated mathematical reasoning.

Meanwhile, xAI has entered another major competition with OpenAI: real-time voice AI.

Grok Voice 3.0, released October 14, reportedly outperformed OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 on the Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech Index.

The independent benchmark numbers tell an interesting story:

Grok Voice 3.0: 86.9
GPT-Live-1 (medium): 83.2

Grok also demonstrated significantly faster response times:

Grok Voice 3.0: 0.81 seconds to first audio
GPT-Live-1: 1.34 seconds

That's approximately 40% less waiting before Grok starts responding.

Grok also showed slightly lower costs per completed task on Big Bench Audio, at 2.5 cents compared with 3 cents for GPT-Live-1.

But the benchmark measuring actual task completion tells a different story.

On tau-Voice, which evaluates whether AI agents can successfully resolve multi-step customer service problems:

GPT-Live-1: 74.5%
Grok Voice 3.0: 71.6%

So Grok leads the overall voice benchmark, but ChatGPT performs better on the test measuring whether customer problems actually get solved.

And this competition is already moving beyond benchmarks.

According to reporting from Business Insider, Grok is handling Starlink customer support calls. xAI reports approximately 20,000 calls daily, with around 70% resolved without human intervention.

That's a significant real-world deployment, but it also means roughly 30% of calls still require human assistance.

Privacy, reliability, complex customer interactions, and the risks of AI making confident mistakes remain important unanswered questions.

These three developments reveal something important about the current state of artificial intelligence.

AI agents can dramatically accelerate research, but generating hypotheses isn't the same as proving discoveries.

AI can produce formally verified mathematical arguments, but verification still depends on whether the formal statements match the original problems.

And AI voice assistants can outperform competitors on headline benchmarks while falling behind on the practical tasks businesses actually care about.

The biggest question isn't simply which company has the most impressive announcement.

It's which results survive independent verification, real-world testing, and human scrutiny.

videos.title: Paul Maurice, Panthers Morning Skate: Florida Breaks Out New Threads v Detroit Red Wings
videos.summary_source_text:
Paul Maurice, Panthers Morning Skate: Florida Breaks Out New Threads v Detroit Red Wings Florida Panthers coach Paul Maurice speaks to the media in Fort Lauderdale before his team plays host to the Detroit Red Wings on Monday, Nov. 2, 2026. 

The Panthers, who have won three straight and six of their past eight, will break out their new pink/coral uniforms as part of the NHL Hometown Remix collection tonight. 

On Friday, Anton Lundell (who had one goal all season) got his first career NHL hat trick in a 5-2 win over the Winnipeg Jets. 

Seth Jones had a goal and two assists giving him 18 points in October. 

Akira Schmid made 22 saves for his third straight win and fifth in the past six. 

Jacob Markstrom starts against the Wings with former Florida goalie Daniil Tarasov going for the Wings.

Florida will play host to the Detroit Red Wings on Monday night.

Video Courtesy Florida Panthers / @FlaPanthers / Panthers Vision

videos.title: Give Me 23 Minutes, I’ll Give You 10,000 Hours of ChatGPT Knowledge
videos.summary_source_text:
Give Me 23 Minutes, I’ll Give You 10,000 Hours of ChatGPT Knowledge GPT-6 isn't just a smarter chatbot anymore. It can build interactive tools, research complex questions, analyze spreadsheets, generate images, remember your projects, and even complete tasks while you're away. But most people are still using ChatGPT like a search engine.

And here's the surprising part: OpenAI reports that GPT-6.1 Terra scored 50.3% on its Agents' Last Exam benchmark, compared to 21.5% for GPT-5.6 Terra. That's more than double the previous score. But there's a major catch behind those numbers, and understanding it could completely change how you use GPT-6.

This is your complete GPT-6 and ChatGPT masterclass in roughly 23 minutes. From choosing the right thinking level to building an automated research-to-presentation workflow, we're breaking down the features, settings, prompts, and limitations that actually matter.

First, there's the GPT-6 model family. Astra, Sol, Luna, and GPT-6.1 Terra aren't interchangeable. Neither are Instant, Medium, High, and Extra High thinking modes. We'll explain what each setting is designed for, how reasoning effort affects performance, and why the most powerful model isn't always the smartest choice for everyday work.

Then there's Intelligent UI, one of GPT-6's most interesting features. Instead of asking ChatGPT how to create a calculator, you can ask it to build an interactive one directly in your conversation. We're talking working bill splitters, adjustable charts, interactive learning tools, and custom interfaces without traditional coding.

But building tools is only the beginning.

Deep Research can investigate complicated questions, browse sources, and produce detailed reports with citations. We'll show you how to structure research prompts, verify sources, identify weak claims, and avoid blindly trusting AI-generated reports.

Next, we'll upload messy spreadsheets into ChatGPT's Data Analysis tool. You'll learn how to identify duplicates, detect missing values, calculate revenue, create interactive charts, and verify calculations using Python. No advanced Excel knowledge required.

We'll also explore ChatGPT Images 2.5, including image editing, sketch-based creation, and targeted changes using comments. Plus, you'll see how ChatGPT Voice can become a practical interview coach, presentation partner, or personal learning assistant.

Then we get into the features that make ChatGPT genuinely useful over time: Memory, Custom Instructions, and Projects.

Learn how to organize your files, create project-specific instructions, control what ChatGPT remembers, and build dedicated workspaces that maintain context across conversations.

And that's where ChatGPT Work enters the picture.

Instead of manually checking emails, preparing reports, or repeating routine tasks, ChatGPT Work can operate across connected apps and handle multi-step workflows. We'll explore scheduled tasks, Gmail automation, draft replies, agent permissions, and why human approval still matters.

Finally, we're connecting everything into one complete workflow:

Deep Research → Source Verification → Data Analysis → ChatGPT Projects → Finished Presentation.

You'll see how these tools work together to turn scattered information into a structured, evidence-backed six-slide decision deck.

But there are limitations worth understanding. AI research can still hallucinate. Spreadsheet analysis can use incorrect methods. Model access depends on your subscription. And even OpenAI's documentation can contain conflicting information.

The real advantage of GPT-6 isn't simply getting better answers. It's knowing how to combine the right tools, provide precise instructions, verify the results, and automate the repetitive work.

Whether you're a beginner learning ChatGPT, a creator building AI workflows, a student doing research, or a professional looking to save hours every week, this guide gives you practical prompts and techniques you can start using immediately.

Kimi Claims His Crown! | Mexico City GP Review | F1 Nation Podcast Kimi Claims His Crown | Mexico City GP Review | F1 Nation Podcast

This episode is sponsored by AWS - Global AI Partner of Formula 1

As Kimi Antonelli becomes the youngest F1 World Champion in history, Tom Clarkson and James Hinchcliffe review the Mexico City Grand Prix.

9th place would have been enough for Antonelli to take the title, but he fought his way to the podium. What does that say about his character? Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton lifted the new champion onto their shoulders on the rostrum. Could Kimi go on to challenge their incredible records?

Race-winner Verstappen showed all his speed and composure to take the victory. What was key to him taking the lead, and is the momentum with him ahead of 2027?

After the Ferraris went wheel-to-wheel, Lewis Hamilton wants 'serious talks'. TC and Hinch assess the situation at the Scuderia and ask what can be done to bring harmony between Hamilton and Leclerc?

How is George Russell feeling now his teammate is officially champion? Does his 2027 title challenge begin in Brazil next week?

Elsewhere there's praise for Liam Lawson after another points finish and we hail Haas stand-in Ryo Hirakawa for a scoring a point on his Grand Prix debut.

⏱️ Timestamps:
🔍 0:00 - Eric Cogorno: how to compress the golf ball with irons and keep your left shoulder back with driver
🧱 0:37 - Adam Scott golf swing vs Justin Thomas: why irons get to the wall and driver stays back
⚠️ 1:36 - Why a left shoulder too far back causes fat and thin shots
📋 2:55 - Golf swing tips for the left shoulder: how far forward, how level, how closed
🖌️ 3:22 - Club across the shoulders drill: how to get your left shoulder over your left ankle
📐 4:45 - How the Adam Scott golf swing levels the shoulders, then works up past impact
🎯 10:03 - How to hit irons ball first without opening your shoulders
🔒 13:20 - Iron swing tips: how neck tilt and a right side crunch keep your shoulders closed
🚀 15:49 - Driver swing tips: why your left shoulder stays back of the wall

Fat shots, thin shots, and irons that never feel compressed often come from a left shoulder that stays too far back in the downswing, while many golfers do the opposite with driver. A recent student of Eric Cogorno's had both patterns, and the Swing Coach app showed his left shoulder well behind his ankle line with irons and well past it with driver. Eric's iron swing tips show how to hit irons by getting the left shoulder to the wall like in Adam Scott's golf swing while keeping the shoulders slightly closed, and his driver swing tips show how Justin Thomas keeps the left shoulder back so you can hit up on the ball. These golf swing tips also cover how to hit fairway woods and long irons, with simple golf tips for how far forward your left shoulder goes with every club. If you leave this video without trying the club across the shoulders drill, you're leaving ball-first, compressed iron shots on the table.

What You'll Learn:
• Why do I hit my irons fat and thin? How a left shoulder too far back moves your low point behind the ball
• How to compress the golf ball by getting your left shoulder to "the wall"
• How do I hit the ball first, then the ground, without coming over the top?
• How the Adam Scott golf swing keeps the shoulders level, then works up through impact
• Why do my shoulders open when I shift forward? Iron swing tips on neck tilt and a right side crunch
• Should my driver swing be different? Driver swing tips on how to hit driver with your left shoulder back, like Justin Thomas
• How far forward should your left shoulder go with fairway woods, hybrids and long irons?
• High handicap golf tips: why your shoulders and lower body move forward together

videos.summary_source_text:
Audi A6 Allroad Review: it proves SUVs are STUPID! Is the Audi A6 Allroad the BEST Audi on sale? 

Get 20% off CarVertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

The all-new Audi A6 Allroad is here! 

It’s the fifth iteration of the A6 Allroad, and Mat’s about to put this one through its paces to see if it has what it takes to stack up against its predecessors. What’s more, he’ll also see how the practicality compares to some of the latest Audi estates and SUVs available today. 

But first up, let’s check out the design… 

Up front, the A6 Allroad sports a few design differences from the regular A6. It’s equipped with an all-new lower bumper, along with a unique and different grille design. There are also additional vents in the lower bumper to help airflow through to the wheels. Along the side, there are widened wheel arches at the front and back, coupled with black cladding on the surrounds and on the sills - you’ll also find black satin roof bars on the top. At the back, once again there’s a new bumper, coupled with some 100% real exhaust tips! 

On the inside, the design language mirrors any recent new Audi release. There’s a large swooping digital dial and infotainment screen, coupled with a passenger screen sitting across the remainder of the dash. There are soft-touch and Alcantara materials along the dash, although reach lower down and you’ll find some scratchy black plastics. The A6 Allroad is fitted with comfortable, figure-hugging sports seats, and there’s a decent enough amount of storage in the cabin. 

There are two engine choices available for the A6 Allroad. The car we have here is equipped with the 3-litre V6 turbo diesel, and this delivers 299hp and 580Nm to all four wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch. You can also choose a 2-litre 4-cylinder plug-in hybrid, and although it comes with a higher power output of 367hp, we think the diesel is the better choice of the two. 

So it sounds like a great car, right? Well, of course, it doesn’t come cheap. The new A6 Allroad starts from £69,700, but for the car we have here in this video, with lots of options added? You’re looking at north of £90,300! So is it worth it? Let us know what you think in the comments!

Carlsson leads Ducks' comeback with 3-assist night! 🦆🇸🇪 #nhlshorts What a game from Leo Carlsson! The Ducks find themselves down 3-0 early to the visiting Senators, before Carlsson and crew respond with SIX unanswered goals to turn the game on its head. Carlsson contributes with 3 assists, first setting up Judd Caulfield's second goal of the game before then assisting on Cutter Gauthier's second and third goals, playing a pivotal role in not just the comeback but Gauthier's hat trick! With the effort, Carlsson ties Lucas Raymond (162) for the third-most points by a Swedish player before age 22 in NHL history, only trailing Mats Sundin (206) and Nicklas Backstrom (180).

Colorado Avalanche outpace Calgary Flames in a dominant 5-2 victory—are signs of a powerhouse resurgence finally emerging? Mackenzie Blackwood flashes elite goaltending with highlight-reel saves, while Cale Makar and Devon Toews fuel the attack from the blue line. The conversation focused on the Avalanche capitalizing against a fatigued Flames squad, showcasing improved team speed, transition play, and a revitalized shot output across all three periods.

A key theme that emerged was the growing stability in Colorado’s defensive pairings despite concerns over Josh Manson’s absence and the performance of depth defenders like Noah Juulsen and Sam Malinski. Veteran Cowboys reporter **Ed Werder** joins DLLS Cowboys insider **Clarence Hill Jr.** following another stunning Dallas Cowboys collapse to explain why Jerry Jones may eventually have NO CHOICE but to make a coaching change.

Werder breaks down the Cowboys' inability to protect a 14-point lead against Arizona, Schottenheimer's overly conservative play calling, and why another disappointing season could force Jerry Jones to reconsider his head coach.

The two longtime Cowboys reporters also discuss Jerry's reluctance to repeat past coaching mistakes, the Cowboys' frustrating lack of consistency, and whether Dallas should even consider investing more draft picks at the NFL trade deadline.

videos.summary_source_text:
Google Just Sent Gemma 4 Into Space and It Answered Back Google just sent Gemma 4 into space, and the AI answered back from an orbiting TPU. Project Suncatcher marks a first for Google's data center chips, but its real goal is far bigger: solar-powered AI data centers built from laser-linked satellites. Meanwhile, Nvidia already has chips in orbit, and Google faces massive challenges with heat, radiation, and launch costs.

📩 Brand Deals & Partnerships: collabs@nouralabs.com
✉️ General Inquiries: airevolutionofficial@gmail.com

🔍 What You'll See
Google's Gemma 4 sends its first reply from orbit on a data center TPU.
SOURCE: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-research/project-suncatcher-satellite-response/
Google's satellite carries 4 TPUs, but only 1 runs for 20 minutes at a time.
SOURCE: https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/30/googles-first-data-center-satellite-is-online-and-writing-poetry/
Google proposes 81 satellites connected by lasers to build huge AI clusters above Earth.
SOURCE: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.joule.2026.102678
Starcloud runs Google's Gemma using Nvidia's H100 in space, beating Google to orbit.
SOURCE: https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/starcloud-runs-ai-model-in-space/

🚨 Why It Matters
AI computing could eventually move beyond Earth, tapping near-constant sunlight to power satellite networks. But cooling chips in a vacuum, surviving radiation, keeping satellites connected, and launching everything cheaply could make the whole idea impractical.

videos.summary_source_text:
The 7 Healthiest Foods You Need in Your Diet Discover the 7 healthiest foods you should include in your diet to support better nutrition, gut health, heart health, and overall wellness. These nutrient-dense foods provide essential vitamins, minerals, healthy fats, protein, and other beneficial nutrients that help your body function at its best.

Watch the FULL video here: ▶️https://youtu.be/fJWPp1EBpYg

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4dRHNk2

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements.

In this video, we explore seven powerful foods that can help you build a healthier, more balanced diet:

1. Raw Sauerkraut – A fermented food containing beneficial bacteria that may support gut health and healthy digestion.

2. Arugula – A nutrient-rich leafy green packed with vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants to support overall health.

3. Wild-Caught Salmon – An excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids and high-quality protein to support heart health and brain function.

4. Cod Liver – A nutrient-dense food containing vitamins A and D, along with beneficial omega-3 fatty acids.

5. Grass-Fed Ground Beef – Provides high-quality protein, vitamin B12, iron, zinc, and other essential nutrients.

6. Brazil Nuts – One of the richest dietary sources of selenium, an essential mineral that supports thyroid function and antioxidant defenses. Just a small amount can provide plenty of selenium.

7. Extra Virgin Olive Oil – Rich in monounsaturated fats and antioxidant compounds that can support cardiovascular health as part of a balanced diet.

WHY THESE 7 HEALTHY FOODS MATTER

Choosing nutrient-dense whole foods is an important step toward improving your daily nutrition. From fermented foods for gut health to omega-3-rich fish, leafy greens, quality protein, selenium-rich nuts, and healthy fats, these foods offer a variety of nutrients your body needs.

videos.title: Your Eyes Can Reveal Liver Problems — Watch for These Warning Signs!  Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
Your Eyes Can Reveal Liver Problems — Watch for These Warning Signs!  Dr. Mandell Your eyes can reveal important warning signs about your liver and your overall health! Your liver works around the clock to filter your blood, process nutrients, metabolize fats, regulate cholesterol, and remove harmful substances from your body. But when your liver is under stress, certain changes in your eyes can provide valuable clues about what's happening inside your body. In this video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains the connection between your eyes and liver health, including yellowing of the whites of your eyes (jaundice), cholesterol deposits around the eyelids (xanthelasma), dry eyes, and persistent redness. Discover how excess sugar, insulin resistance, fatty liver disease, inflammation, and unhealthy lifestyle habits can affect your liver and overall well-being. You'll also learn the importance of proper nutrition, fiber, antioxidants, and healthy daily habits that support liver function. Some eye changes have many possible causes and do not necessarily indicate liver disease, but understanding these warning signs can help you recognize when further medical evaluation is important. Your liver is one of the hardest-working organs in your body, and protecting it is essential for long-term health. Share this important information with your friends and family, and remember to make it a great day! videos.summary_source_text:
It's Weird, But it Drops Body Fat Faster Than Dieting! Want to lose weight without counting calories, tracking macros, or weighing every bite of food? You can. In this video, I’m showing you a simple, visual way to eat for fat loss using the food already on your plate. No calorie-counting app, complicated diet rules, or endless food math required.

Subscribe to this channel here - http://bit.ly/2b0coMW

Here’s the truth: calories still matter. If your goal is to lose body fat, your overall calorie intake has to support that goal. But that does NOT mean you have to spend your day adding up numbers to make progress. The easier you can make your nutrition plan to follow, the better your chances of sticking with it long enough to get results—and KEEP them.

I’m Jeff Cavaliere, physical therapist and strength coach, and I want to show you the plate method I still use myself. If you’re wondering how to lose weight without counting calories, you can try it at your very next meal.

FREE CARBOHYDRATE FOOD LISTS:
https://athleanx.com/carbs

First, look at your dinner plate and divide it visually into three equal sections. Dedicate one-third to PROTEIN: chicken, steak, fish, or another protein source you enjoy. Vegetarian or vegan? You can use plant-based options such as lentils, chickpeas, and other foods that fit the way you eat.

Now look at the remaining two-thirds. This is where your carbohydrate choices make a difference. I divide them into two categories: fibrous carbs and starchy carbs.

FIBROUS CARBOHYDRATES include broccoli, carrots, onions, mushrooms, and other vegetables you actually like. These foods typically provide more volume for fewer calories and help make your meals filling.

STARCHY CARBOHYDRATES include sweet potatoes, pasta, and similar foods. You do NOT have to eliminate them to lose fat. They’re especially valuable when you train hard and need fuel for your workouts.

If your main priority is losing a significant amount of body fat, give more of the remaining plate space to fibrous vegetables and a smaller section to starchy carbohydrates. You can still enjoy potatoes and pasta; you’re simply controlling the proportions visually instead of calculating every calorie.

If you're training consistently and need more fuel for performance, reverse that balance: more room for starches and less for vegetables, while keeping your protein section. I’ll show you how I put together a meal with chicken, sweet potatoes, pasta, and edamame to support my own training.

What about FATS? They’re included in how you prepare the meal: olive oil for sautéing vegetables, the fat in your protein preparation, or a reasonable amount of butter on a sweet potato. Just be mindful of how much you add. Oils and butter still contribute calories, even when you’re not counting them.

There’s also one mistake that can undermine this entire approach: PILING YOUR FOOD TOO HIGH.

One-third of a plate doesn’t mean a six-inch mountain of food. Look at your plate from the SIDE as well as from above. That second view helps you judge portion sizes, not just the surface area each food occupies. If you’re trying to lose weight without tracking every serving, this matters.

What if your weight loss stalls? You don't need to cut out all carbs or abandon the plan. Start by shifting some of the starchy portion toward fibrous vegetables. If you still need to adjust, give a little more room to satiating protein while slightly reducing the carbohydrate portion. These are small, repeatable changes—not an extreme diet overhaul.

The best fat loss diet is one you can stick with. Tracking calories can help, but using a food scale, calorie calculator, and daily tally for every meal gets exhausting. It’s not the only way to manage energy intake.

• How to portion your plate for weight loss without counting calories
• Why protein comes first when planning a meal
• How fibrous carbs differ from starchy carbohydrates
• How to adjust carbohydrates for fat loss or athletic performance
• Why food portion HEIGHT matters, not just plate space
• What to change when your weight loss progress slows

This isn’t a magic belly fat-burning food list or a metabolism hack. Nor am I saying that a calorie deficit doesn’t matter. I’m showing you a straightforward system that can help you manage calories WITHOUT constantly thinking about calories. You make better food choices, monitor your progress, and adjust your portions when necessary.

videos.title: Elektriska Porsche Cayenne – Flipp eller Flopp?
videos.summary_source_text:
Elektriska Porsche Cayenne – Flipp eller Flopp? När första Porsche Cayenne kom skakade purister på huvudet – men den blev en enorm succé. Nu står Porsche inför samma prövning igen: Nya Cayenne är helt elektrisk. Kan en el-suv på 2,6 ton leverera äkta Porsche-känsla, och vågar köparna satsa efter Taycans värdeminskning?

Jag provkör nya elektriska Porsche Cayenne med över 600 hästkrafter. Synar köregenskaperna, den knivskarpa styrningen, interiören och praktiska familjeutrymmen som bagage och frunk. Dessutom testar jag snabbladdningen (10–80 %). Är detta Porsches bästa suv någonsin?

videos.title: GPT 7 Is Here: OpenAI’s 10 Trillion Parameter Massive Upgrade!
videos.summary_source_text:
GPT 7 Is Here: OpenAI’s 10 Trillion Parameter Massive Upgrade! Ottokit Link: https://ottokit.com/?aff=14ca2272

GPT-7 leaks are everywhere. Alleged benchmark scores, massive parameter counts, and predictions that OpenAI's next AI model could finally achieve AGI. But here's the problem: almost none of it is confirmed.

So what could GPT-7 actually do? And could it be the AI breakthrough that changes everything?

OpenAI's GPT-6 has already pushed AI reasoning, coding, mathematics, and autonomous computer use to extraordinary levels. GPT-6 Astra reportedly scores 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3, while GPT-6.1 Sol delivers competitive coding performance at a fraction of the cost. Yet even the most advanced models still hallucinate, struggle with long-running tasks, and make mistakes that compound over time.

That's what makes GPT-7 so interesting. The real question isn't whether it will score higher on benchmarks. It's whether OpenAI can solve the reliability, memory, planning, and autonomy problems preventing today's AI agents from handling genuinely complex work.

In this video, we separate GPT-7 rumors from verified developments and use the progression from GPT-4 through GPT-5 and GPT-6 to explore what OpenAI's next generation could realistically achieve.

First, we examine what's actually confirmed. OpenAI has not publicly announced GPT-7 specifications, benchmarks, pricing, or a release date. However, reports suggest that a significant portion of its research already focuses on future generations beyond GPT-6.

Then we examine the numbers.

GPT-5.2 reportedly achieved approximately 53% on ARC-AGI-2, while GPT-6 Astra has demonstrated major advances in reasoning, scientific research, and computer automation. Context windows have expanded dramatically, coding agents are becoming more capable, and AI systems can increasingly interact with real software.

Independent research from METR suggests that the length of tasks AI can complete reliably has been doubling approximately every seven months. If that trend continues, GPT-7 could potentially manage multi-hour workflows with significantly less human supervision.

Imagine an AI that can build applications from plain-English instructions, coordinate specialized agents, remember project details across months, and independently conduct portions of scientific research.

We examine whether GPT-7 could genuinely qualify as Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), including the difference between exceptional benchmark performance and the ability to learn, plan, and adapt across unfamiliar situations.

Google's Gemini 3 Deep Think, Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, and increasingly capable open-source models are creating an AI race where performance, reliability, cost, and privacy could matter more than which company releases the biggest model.

There's also the infrastructure behind the intelligence: massive computing requirements, advanced chips, energy consumption, and the growing concentration of AI development among a handful of companies.

Then come the risks.

More capable AI agents could accelerate cybersecurity defenses while enabling more sophisticated attacks. Persistent memory introduces privacy challenges. Greater autonomy increases the consequences of mistakes, and AI alignment remains an unresolved problem.

Finally, we explore three realistic GPT-7 scenarios:

SCENARIO A: Incremental Progress
GPT-7 becomes faster, cheaper, more accurate, and more capable without fundamentally changing how AI works.

SCENARIO B: Transformative AI
GPT-7 develops reliable multi-hour autonomy, persistent memory, and coordinated AI agents capable of handling substantial professional workflows.

SCENARIO C: The AGI Breakthrough
GPT-7 approaches general intelligence, contributes to designing more advanced AI systems, and dramatically accelerates scientific discovery.

Which future is actually supported by today's evidence?

This isn't another GPT-7 leak video. It's an evidence-based forecast examining the benchmarks, technical limitations, research trends, competition, and unanswered questions that will determine what comes next.

Watch until the end for the most realistic scenario, the signals worth monitoring, and practical steps you can take to prepare for increasingly capable AI.

Which GPT-7 scenario do you believe is most likely: incremental progress, transformative AI, or an AGI breakthrough?

Let us know in the comments.

Great Chippers Move Up Through Impact  #golfswing #golftips Many golfers are told to keep their head down when chipping, but that advice often leads to fat, heavy strikes. Moving down through impact encourages you to hold angles too long, causing the low point to happen before the ball. The best players actually move up and around through contact, allowing the club to release naturally. This creates cleaner contact and much better control around the greens.

videos.title: Longevity Secrets to Help You Live 100 Years
videos.summary_source_text:
Longevity Secrets to Help You Live 100 Years Everyone wants to live a long, healthy life.

But what can you actually do to make that a reality?

Watch the FULL video here:▶️https://youtu.be/zs1a8tFsvdc

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4xodMji

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements.

It turns out there are some really practical, science-backed steps you can take.

For example, maintaining optimal vitamin D levels is crucial.

Many people think their levels are fine, but getting them regularly checked can reveal a different story.

And regular exercise isn’t just for weight management. It supports so many body functions that contribute to longevity.

Avoiding seed oils and excessive sugar is also key. These things can create metabolic stress that directly impacts your body’s ability to maintain healthy cells over time.

Think about cooking with herbs like parsley, thyme, oregano, and basil. They aren’t just for flavor; they’re packed with phytonutrients that can support your cells and overall well-being.

Intermittent fasting is another powerful tool. It helps your body repair and renew cells, essentially cleaning house at a cellular level.

And don’t underestimate the power of social connections. Research shows that fostering strong relationships can have a significant positive impact on how long and how well you live.

Eating fermented foods supports a healthy gut microbiome, which is foundational for nutrient absorption and immune function.

Drinking lemon water daily and taking post-meal walks are simple ways to support digestion and steady blood sugar levels.

Even avoiding cooking in iron skillets can make a difference for some, by helping to manage iron levels in the body.

And, of course, getting 7-9 hours of quality sleep every night is non-negotiable for repair, hormone balance, and overall vitality.

All of these choices can contribute to a long and healthy life.

But when it comes to supporting your overall health, it can be hard to know where to begin. Everyone’s body is different, and what works for one person may not work for another.

1 cup (200 g) cooked chickpeas.
1/2 cup (50 g) oats.
2 tbsp chia seeds. 2 tbsp nutritional yeast.
Salt. 2 tbsp olive oil.
1/4 cup (60 ml) water.
Let sit for 15 mins.
Bake in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 30 mins.

The PGA Tour heads to Vidanta Vallarta for the VidantaWorld Mexico Open, the fifth event of the FedExCup Fall, with crucial points up for grabs. Wyndham Clark headlines the field after a three-win season, while Tom Kim returns following his Asian Games gold medal and Brian Campbell looks to become the tournament’s first back-to-back winner. Ben Griffin, Blades Brown and past champion Tony Finau add further quality, with Aldrich Potgieter back after losing a playoff to Campbell last year. With several players battling around the FedExCup top-100 bubble, the stakes are high in Mexico as the season approaches its conclusion.

videos.summary_source_text:
The #1 Thing Making You Sick—and How to Stop It | Dr. Mandell What if the biggest strain on your health isn’t one food, one stressful conversation, or one bad night—but the daily load that keeps building without giving your body a chance to recover? In this video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains how physical stress, emotional pressure, poor sleep, too little movement, and repeated unhealthy eating habits can add up over time. You’ll hear why one pastry or stressful day doesn’t tell the whole story, how patterns matter, and how small changes can help reduce the load: add protein and fruit to breakfast, take a short walk after a meal, set a reasonable boundary, or give yourself more time to wind down before bed. You don’t have to change everything at once or live perfectly; start with one step you can repeat. Ongoing symptoms can have many causes, so don’t assume stress is the explanation—talk with a qualified healthcare professional about persistent health concerns.

videos.title: Google’s Gemini 5 Is Here: A 10 Trillion Parameter Massive Leap!
videos.summary_source_text:
Google’s Gemini 5 Is Here: A 10 Trillion Parameter Massive Leap! Try UNLIMITED SeeDance 2.5 on OpenArt: https://openart.ai/home?utm_source=yo...

Gemini 5 is supposedly coming with a 10-million-token context window, 10 trillion parameters, and a leaked release date. But there's one major problem: Google hasn't confirmed any of it.

Meanwhile, Google just announced Gemini 4 Carbon, a model that reportedly topped the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 59, beating Claude Opus 5.5 by one point. It launched at half the price of Claude Opus 5.5, but almost nobody could actually use it.

And buried in Google's pricing details is a footnote that completely changes that half-price advantage.

Google has released two major Gemini 4 models in just four weeks.

Gemini 4 Argon arrived on September 30, targeting advanced software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and cybersecurity. Google advertised an extraordinary one-million-token output limit, although third-party listings disagree on the actual per-request limit.

Argon initially launched through Google DeepMind's Fairwind Program before becoming generally available on October 13 through Google AI Studio, Vertex AI, and supported Gemini subscriptions.

Then, on October 28, Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon.

Carbon focuses on sustained software engineering and cybersecurity defense, with Google reporting an 88.2% result on SEC-bench Pro. Artificial Analysis ranked it first on its Intelligence Index v5 with a score of 59.

But Carbon wasn't immediately available through the public Gemini API, Gemini app, or Google Search AI Mode. Access was restricted to selected cybersecurity defenders.

Then there's the Gemini 5 controversy.

Online rumors claim Gemini 5 will feature a 10-million-token context window, 10 trillion parameters, and a revolutionary mixture-of-experts architecture.

But Google's official announcements, DeepMind model documentation, and public API listings provide no confirmation of those specifications.

The 10-million-token claim appears connected to older Gemini 1.5 Pro speculation. The 10-trillion-parameter figure has no verified source, and Google hasn't publicly disclosed parameter counts for its flagship Gemini models.

The actual Gemini 4 benchmarks tell a much more interesting story.

Google reports that Gemini 4 Argon achieved 77.9% on DeepSWE 1.1. Internal engineering examples include migrating approximately 800,000 lines of C and C++ to Rust and accelerating a 32,000-line video decoder by roughly 2.7 times.

Independent benchmark results are promising too.

On the Vals Index, Argon scored 68.9%, compared with Claude Opus 5.5 at 67.0%, Claude Fable 5.1 at 65.8%, and GPT-6 Astra at 63.1%.

But Google doesn't dominate every benchmark.

GPT-6 Astra outperformed Argon on Terminal-Bench Science, scoring 68.1% against 57.6%. Carbon also trails competing models on certain software engineering and computer-use evaluations.

And different independent leaderboards don't always agree about which model deserves first place.

Then comes the pricing controversy.

Gemini 4 Argon launched at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. Claude Opus 5.5 costs $4 and $20 respectively.

That's a genuine 50% introductory discount.

But Google's pricing footnote states that Argon's rates increase to $4 input and $20 output on December 1.

Suddenly, the advertised half-price advantage disappears.

Carbon's announced rates are also introductory, although the script identifies no confirmed expiration date for its promotional pricing.

We also examine how Google's TPU infrastructure, including Trillium and Ironwood, helps explain its rapid model development cycle, and why distribution through Search, Android, Chrome, Workspace, and Google Cloud gives Gemini a unique competitive advantage.

The bigger question isn't whether Google can eventually release Gemini 5.

It's whether a future Gemini 5 can demonstrate independently verified improvements in reasoning, coding, cybersecurity, autonomous agents, and reliability that justify another generational leap.

Because right now, the verified story is Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon, not the rumored Gemini 5 specifications.

Watch for Carbon's public release, independent benchmark results, and Argon's December 1 pricing change.

videos.title: Still slicing your driver? Please check this...
videos.summary_source_text:
Still slicing your driver? Please check this... Still slicing your driver? Check your right elbow 👀

https://sbrew.link/nCSai79n

Save this golf drill for your next practice session and send it to a golfer who’s tired of missing right!

If the tip of your right elbow never gets in front of your shirt seam during the downswing, your hips and shoulders may spin open sending the club across the ball and straight into “sliced city.” 🏌️‍♂️➡️

Try this instead: let your arms drop, tuck your right elbow just in front of your shirt seam, and allow the club to shallow behind you. This helps you approach the ball from the inside so you can hit straighter drives, create a draw, and find more fairways.

The Blue Brick makes this drill even more effective by giving you instant feedback when you spin out or come over the top.

Ready to fix your slice and build a more consistent driver swing?

videos.title: I Tested Voice Prompting on ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini… The Results Surprised Me (Typeless)
videos.summary_source_text:
I Tested Voice Prompting on ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini… The Results Surprised Me (Typeless) Typeless Link: https://www.typeless.com/?via=1014

What if you could write complex AI prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok without typing a single word? I tested Typeless, an AI-powered voice dictation tool, across four increasingly difficult challenges to see whether speaking to AI is faster, easier, and accurate enough to replace typing.

The results were surprisingly good. Typeless handled last-minute corrections, technical terminology, exact percentages, and complicated research instructions. But it also made mistakes that could change the meaning of a prompt.

Typeless isn’t another AI chatbot. It’s a voice-to-text tool that turns natural, messy speech into clean, structured text, so you can change your mind mid-sentence, add requirements, and still end up with a usable prompt.

ROUND 1: CHATGPT — CORRECTIONS AND FORMATTING
I built a marketing prompt for a small coffee shop, changing a three-day campaign into a seven-day launch plan, cutting the budget from $500 to under $300, and adding formatting requirements. Typeless preserved the corrections and kept the staffing and advertising-cost restrictions.

ROUND 2: CLAUDE — TECHNICAL TERMS AND EXACT NUMBERS
I dictated an AI evaluation framework covering factual accuracy, reasoning quality, response consistency, inference latency, and hallucinations, with exact scoring weights of 30%, 25%, 20%, 15%, and 10%. Typeless captured the vocabulary, percentages, comparison-table requirements, and restrictions against inventing benchmark results.

ROUND 3: GEMINI — MIXED-LANGUAGE DICTATION
I mixed English and Spanish to create seven bilingual social media posts for a Los Angeles coffee shop. Typeless handled most instructions, including changing five posts to seven, but turned “visítanos hoy” into “Visítenos,” dropping a word. That’s minor for brainstorming, but a real problem when exact wording matters.

ROUND 4: GROK — COMPLEX RESEARCH INSTRUCTIONS
I dictated a detailed brief on multimodal AI, RAG, inference costs, and hallucination mitigation, requiring a 150-word executive summary, four technical sections, uncertainty classifications, a comparison table, and three viewer questions. Typeless preserved the structure and the restriction on separating confirmed information from predictions. Still, accurate transcription doesn’t guarantee Grok will produce accurate research.

DOES VOICE PROMPTING ACTUALLY SAVE TIME?
Illustrative example: typing a detailed prompt takes 1:45, while speaking it takes 30 seconds plus 15 seconds of review. That’s roughly a 57% saving. These aren’t measured benchmarks; your results will depend on your typing speed, speaking pace, and how much editing is needed.

FINAL VERDICT
Voice prompting is genuinely useful for brainstorming, content planning, technical instructions, and longer AI workflows. But Typeless isn’t perfect: the opening demo missed several instructions, and the Gemini test showed problems with exact Spanish wording. Is the smarter approach voice dictation plus a quick manual review?

Signs Your Body May Be Missing These Nutrients Nutritional deficiencies can cause noticeable changes in your skin, hair, nails, and overall health. Many of these symptoms are linked to specific vitamins and minerals your body needs to function properly.

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://www.drberg.com/health-lever-quiz

Here are some signs of nutritional deficiencies.
• Pale skin: vitamin B12
• Cracked corners of the mouth: vitamin B2
• Ridges on fingernails: iron
• White spots on nails: zinc
• Bleeding gums: vitamin C
• Thinning outer eyebrows: iodine
• Restless legs at night: magnesium
• Calf cramps: magnesium
• Thinning hair: biotin
• Cold hands and feet: vitamin B12
• Dark circles under the eyes: iron or vitamin K
• Craving ice: iron
• Dandruff: omega-3 fatty acids

videos.title: Be PATIENT in the downswing #golfswing #golftips
videos.summary_source_text:
Be PATIENT in the downswing #golfswing #golftips Be PATIENT in the downswing
We talk so much about creating a good pivot in the back swing, this will set you up perfectly to create a good transition.
As we start with the lower body, feel your arms to drop down towards your right hip rather than forward towards the golf ball.  The hands will feel like they are dropping more vertically which will help you get in the “slot” and in turn set you up to move the body better through impact. Be PATIENT in the downswing

videos.title: Once He Understood This Concept, His Golf Swing Felt Effortless
videos.summary_source_text:
Once He Understood This Concept, His Golf Swing Felt Effortless Struggle with inconsistent ball striking even though you feel like you’re trying really hard to make a good golf swing?

In this Danny Maude golf lesson, you’ll watch a real lesson with Leo, a beginner golfer who only plays around once a month. Leo was struggling to strike his irons consistently and couldn’t generate much extra distance no matter how much effort he put into his golf swing.

The breakthrough came when he stopped trying to control the golf club and started doing something much simpler: **feeling the weight of the clubhead and allowing it to swing.**

Almost immediately, his golf swing became smoother, his strike improved and the club started trailing naturally in the downswing without him consciously trying to create lag.

In this golf lesson you’ll learn:

• How to improve your iron ball striking without trying harder  
• Why consciously trying to hold lag can ruin your golf swing  
• How to feel the weight of the golf club during the swing  
• Why letting the clubhead fall can improve your downswing  
• How to stop releasing the golf club too early  
• Why your body can organise itself around the swinging clubhead  
• How one-handed golf swings can improve your feel  
• Why giving up control can actually give you more control  
• How to create better rhythm and tempo naturally  
• How to stay present instead of thinking about swing positions  
• How to add clubhead speed without losing your strike  
• Why better ball striking can create extra distance without extra effort  

One of the biggest changes in Leo’s swing came when he stopped asking, **“How do I do this?”**

Instead, his attention moved onto what the clubhead was doing in real time.

Could he feel its weight?  
Could he feel it falling?  
Could he allow his body to react to the swinging golf club?

As soon as that happened, many of the golf swing positions we were looking for started appearing naturally.

This is why feeling the clubhead can be so valuable. Rather than consciously controlling your arms, wrists, hips and shoulders, you give your body something meaningful to respond to.

The result can be a golf swing that feels freer, more rhythmical and — as Leo discovered — considerably more effortless.

Thanks for stopping by.  I created this website as a resource just for you to support you on your golfing journey as I know how tricky learning this game can be…to say the least!

I personally found learning the game too long and difficult in the early days. I read all the books, watched all the videos but my game was not improving. Then after studying various forms of neuro science, motor learning, psychology and personal development in less than two years I went from struggling golfer to the final stage of the Open Championship.

On YouTube and my personal website (www.dannymaude.com) I will bring you the most up to date training, training that is getting tangible results for my clients right now.  I don’t know where you are in your golfing journey, you could be just starting out or maybe your body isn’t as flexible as it once was or you’ve got ambitions to slash your handicap.  Wherever you are I’ve created a place here you can learn, share your ideas, ask questions and get all the support you need to enjoy this great game.

Be prepared though. If its a quick fix you are after Im not your man. Here I will give you step-by-step advice that you can take straight to the practice ground and apply to the course but it will require you to get stuck in, screw up…a lot, practice some more and then watch those scores tumble

I’ve had the pleasure of coaching thousands of students all around the world and if you are up for the challenge and are ready to get in the game…LETS GO TO WORK!

Discover what an enlarged prostate really means, the connection to benign prostatic hyperplasia, and the common causes of high PSA that don’t always indicate prostate cancer.

There have been over 300,000 new cases of prostate cancer diagnosed this year, but most men diagnosed with prostate cancer won’t die from it. Why is that?

The prostate is a gland that wraps around the urethra and produces fluid that helps transport sperm. Normally the size of a walnut, the prostate can become enlarged, sometimes reaching the size of a ping pong ball or even a lemon.

Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) is a common cause of an enlarged prostate. Sometimes it affects urination, and sometimes it doesn’t.

High PSA levels can be associated with prostate cancer, but they don’t necessarily indicate cancer. There are several other causes of high PSA levels, including prostate enlargement.

High levels of DHT, a powerful form of testosterone, and elevated insulin can both contribute to prostate enlargement. Maintaining adequate vitamin D and zinc is also important for supporting normal prostate size and overall prostate health.

To support a healthy prostate, focus on the following:
1. Adequate vitamin D
2. Healthy insulin levels
3. Avoiding xenoestrogens
4. Sufficient zinc
5. Intermittent and prolonged fasting

Are TUNED cars a WASTE of MONEY? Honda Civic Type R DRAG RACE Are tuned cars a waste of time?! 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-31-10

Who’s ready for an almighty Honda drag race!

We’ve got our hands on a standard Honda Civic Type R, and we’re about to put it up against a whole load of tuned Civic Type Rs to see if the various tunes and modifications have been worth it. 

The Honda Civic Type R is powered by a 2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder that produces 329hp and 420Nm. It sends that power to the front wheels via a 6-speed manual and weighs in at 1,429. The total cost is £46,995. 

Now let’s take a look at the contenders: 

Tuned FL5: 420hp, 570Nm, 1,430kg, £67,000
Tuned EP3 #1: 440hp, 450Nm, 1,204kg, £21,000
Tuned EP3 #2: 450hp, 360Nm, 1,204kg, £23,000
Tuned EK9: 505hp, 404Nm, 1,070kg, £45,300

However, if Mat gets beaten by any of these contenders, he has another car to jump into: an all-new Honda NSX! This is powered by a 3.5-litre twin-turbo V6, coupled with 3 electric motors. These combine to produce 581hp and 645Nm, with power sent to all four wheels via a 9-speed dual-clutch gearbox! It weighs in at 1,759kg, and as new it costs around £149,995.

BUT, that’s not all… There’s a final boss EJ2 Coupe waiting in the wings with an absolutely insane amount of power! Will it have what it takes to bring down all other contenders? You’ll need to stick with Mat to see for yourself!

30.10.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

RIFT — THE NEXT-GEN AFFILIATE OS

Learn. Participate. Manage Risk. Think Bigger.
